name: Object-level authorization boundary
objective: Check whether an approved object endpoint enforces authorization on each request.
preconditions: The approved scope includes an object endpoint path
steps: Request the approved object endpoint without any credential and capture the response.
Compare the response against the endpoint's stated policy: an object that requires authorization must not return content to an unauthenticated request.
Report a candidate only when the unauthenticated response returns object content rather than a refusal.
falsePositives: A deliberately public endpoint returns content by design; confirm the endpoint's intent before reporting.
A generic error page returned with status 200 is not object content.

finding.title: Object endpoint answers an unauthenticated request
finding.summary: The approved object endpoint returned object content to a request that carried no credential.
